sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日新闻简报《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Today, episode five of our series, Day X.
sentences.zh: 今天，是我们系列节目《X日》的第五集。

sentences.en: A year and a half into my reporting,
sentences.zh: 在我的报道进行了一年半之后，

sentences.en: In late August 2020, tens of thousands of people flooded the streets of Berlin,
sentences.zh: 2020年8月下旬，成千上万的人涌上柏林街头，

sentences.en: protesting the government's coronavirus lockdown measures.
sentences.zh: 抗议政府的新冠疫情封锁措施。

sentences.en: There were anti-vaxxers, QAnon followers, several thousand members of the far-right scene.
sentences.zh: 人群中有反疫苗者、匿名者Q（QAnon）的追随者，还有几千名极右翼势力的成员。

sentences.en: Some of these groups had been chatting on Telegram, calling for a storm on Berlin and posting images of themselves with their weapons.
sentences.zh: 其中一些团体一直在Telegram上聊天，呼吁冲击柏林，并发布了他们携带武器的照片。

sentences.en: And as the day went on, a few hundred of them gathered directly in front of Germany's parliament building, the Reichstag.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，几百人直接聚集在德国议会大厦——国会大厦前。

sentences.en: Most of them were white men, many of them from far-right groups.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数是白人男性，许多来自极右翼团体。

sentences.en: They were waving the old black, white and red flag of the German Empire that once inspired the Nazis
sentences.zh: 他们挥舞着曾经激励过纳粹的德意志帝国旧黑白红旗，

sentences.en: and has now become the flag of choice for neo-Nazis because the swastika is banned.
sentences.zh: 由于纳粹旗被禁，这面旗帜现在已成为新纳粹分子的首选旗帜。

sentences.en: And it's that evening, hours into the protest, when a woman got up on stage in front of the Capitol and told the crowd, we are writing history in Berlin here today.
sentences.zh: 就在那天晚上，抗议持续了数小时后，一名女子爬上国会大厦前的舞台对人群说，我们今天在柏林书写历史。

sentences.en: There are no more police.
sentences.zh: 警察已经没有了。

sentences.en: We have won.
sentences.zh: 我们赢了。

sentences.en: The crowd went wild.
sentences.zh: 人群陷入了疯狂。

sentences.en: And just like that, they headed straight for the Reichstag, shouting things like Widerstand, resistance, and Wir sind das Volk, we are the people.
sentences.zh: 就这样，他们径直冲向国会大厦，高喊着“Widerstand”（抵抗）和“Wir sind das Volk”（我们是人民）。

sentences.en: They broke through the police barrier and ran up the main stairs.
sentences.zh: 他们冲破了警察的防线，跑上了主楼梯。

sentences.en: And when they made it to the top, in front of the main entrance to parliament, some of them tried to get inside.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达顶部，站在议会正门前时，一些人试图闯入。

sentences.en: night.
sentences.zh: 夜晚。

sentences.en: The only thing stopping them were three police officers who were able to hold the line until backup arrived.
sentences.zh: 唯一阻挡他们的是三名警察，他们成功守住了防线，直到增援部队赶到。

sentences.en: The whole thing only lasted for a few minutes, but it led Germany's president to call it an unbearable attack on the heart of democracy.
sentences.zh: 整个过程只持续了几分钟，但却导致德国总统称其为对民主核心的无法容忍的攻击。

sentences.en: It all happened four months before rioters stromped the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这一切发生在暴徒冲击美国国会大厦的四个月前，

sentences.en: Capitol on January 6th, some with military and police backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 即1月6日，其中一些人有军事和警察背景。

sentences.en: And it all made me think how my reporting on far-right infiltration had started.
sentences.zh: 这一切让我回想起我对极右翼渗透的报道是如何开始的。

sentences.en: With a gun in an airport bathroom and a military officer accused of wanting to bring down the
sentences.zh: 从机场厕所里的一把枪，以及一名被指控想要推翻

sentences.en: Federal Republic of Germany.
sentences.zh: 德意志联邦共和国的军官开始。

sentences.en: In many ways, Francois' case felt exceptional.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，弗朗索瓦的案件看起来是个例外。

sentences.en: But the attempted storming of the Reichstag and everything else I've seen in my reporting made it clear that it's not.
sentences.zh: 但试图冲击国会大厦的事件以及我在报道中看到的一切都清楚地表明，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And so I wasn't all that surprised when I learned that at the demonstrations in Berlin, there were several police officers, military reservists, and people who fantasize about the
sentences.zh: 所以，当我得知在柏林的示威活动中，有几名警察、预备役军人，以及那些幻想

sentences.en: day when the democratic order collapses.
sentences.zh: 民主秩序崩溃之日的人时，我并不感到惊讶。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Katrin Benholt.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的卡特琳·本霍尔特。

sentences.en: this is day x when i started my reporting on franco a it was clear that the institutions
sentences.zh: 这是《X日》。当我开始报道弗朗索瓦·A时，很明显，那些

sentences.en: responsible for identifying him let alone the network his case uncovered were largely blind to the threat of far-right extremism two years later after everything
sentences.zh: 负责识别他，更不用说他案件所揭露的网络的相关机构，对极右翼极端主义的威胁基本上是视而不见的。两年后，在经历了这一切之后

sentences.en: that's happened i wanted to see how much that's changed so oh there we are i think that's it
sentences.zh: ，我想看看情况改变了多少。哦，我们到了，我想就是这儿。

sentences.en: In April 2021, producer Caitlin Roberts and I go to the Military Counterintelligence Agency.
sentences.zh: 2021年4月，制片人凯特琳·罗伯茨和我前往军事反情报局。

sentences.en: Oh, they're already waiting for us.
sentences.zh: 哦，他们已经在等我们了。

sentences.en: Look at that.
sentences.zh: 看那个。

sentences.en: They're going to shut us off immediately.
sentences.zh: 他们会立刻切断我们的采访。

sentences.en: It's the smallest of Germany's three federal intelligence agencies.
sentences.zh: 这是德国三个联邦情报机构中规模最小的一个。

sentences.en: And one of its core missions is to monitor extremism inside the military.
sentences.zh: 其核心任务之一是监控军队内部的极端主义。

sentences.en: This is the first time they're speaking to me on the record.
sentences.zh: 这是他们第一次正式接受我的采访。

sentences.en: And the interview is tightly controlled.
sentences.zh: 而且采访受到严格控制。

sentences.en: We're not allowed to ask about Franco A, because it's an ongoing case.
sentences.zh: 我们不允许询问关于弗朗索瓦·A的问题，因为案件仍在审理中。

sentences.en: We actually had to submit all our questions in advance.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上必须提前提交所有问题。

sentences.en: And we can't turn our recorder back on.
sentences.zh: 而且我们不能重新打开录音机。

sentences.en: Are we rolling?
sentences.zh: 开始录了吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Until we're walking up to the conference room,
sentences.zh: 直到我们走进会议室，

sentences.en: where we meet one of the vice presidents, Burkhard Ewen.
sentences.zh: 在那里我们见到了副局长之一，伯克哈德·尤恩。

sentences.en: He's a civilian and has only been there for two years.
sentences.zh: 他是文职人员，在那里工作才两年。

sentences.en: He was brought in as part of a sweeping effort to address the agency's failures in how it handled far-right extremism.
sentences.zh: 他被引入是为了全面解决该机构在处理极右翼极端主义方面的失败。

sentences.en: And the first question I have for him is the same one I started with two years ago.
sentences.zh: 我问他的第一个问题，和我两年前开始调查时问的一样。

sentences.en: When I first called the defense ministry, the guy I spoke to told me the confirmed number of extremists was in single digits and falling.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次致电国防部时，与我交谈的人告诉我，确认的极端分子人数是个位数，而且还在下降。

sentences.en: He said there were four.
sentences.zh: 他说只有四个人。

sentences.en: What are the latest numbers?
sentences.zh: 最新的数字是多少？

sentences.en: How many cases of extremism are you looking at inside the German military today?
sentences.zh: 今天你们在德国军队内部调查多少起极端主义案件？

sentences.en: Burkhardt tells me that the number of far-right extremists they've identified in the military has grown significantly.
sentences.zh: 伯克哈德告诉我，他们在军队中确认的极右翼极端分子数量已经显著增加。

sentences.en: The most recent data they have shows 32 confirmed cases and 843 suspected ones.
sentences.zh: 他们最新的数据显示有32起确认案件和843起疑似案件。

sentences.en: And he says about two dozen of those are in the most elite and highly trained unit,
sentences.zh: 他说其中大约有二十几人是在最精锐、训练有素的部队中，

sentences.en: the KSK.
sentences.zh: 即KSK（特种部队司令部）。

sentences.en: The unit has become a special focus after a series of scandals.
sentences.zh: 在一系列丑闻之后，该部队已成为特别关注的焦点。

sentences.en: Several soldiers were reported to have flashed Hitler salutes at a party.
sentences.zh: 据报道，几名士兵在聚会上行纳粹礼。

sentences.en: And at least one of them had stolen military-grade plastic explosives, an AK-47, and collected SS memorabilia.
sentences.zh: 其中至少一人偷窃了军用塑料炸药、一把AK-47，并收集了党卫军纪念品。

sentences.en: They also discovered that nearly 50,000 rounds of ammunition and 137 pounds of explosives had gone missing from their arsenal.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现，军火库中丢失了近5万发弹药和137磅炸药。

sentences.en: It reached the point where the defense minister took the unprecedented step to disband an entire fighting company, one of only four,
sentences.zh: 情况严重到国防部长采取了前所未有的措施，解散了整个作战连队（仅有的四个连队之一），

sentences.en: because it had become so infested with far-right extremism.
sentences.zh: 因为它已经被极右翼极端主义严重侵蚀。

sentences.en: And of course, the far-right network Franco A was a part of was started by a KSK soldier.
sentences.zh: 当然，弗朗索瓦·A所属的极右翼网络是由一名KSK士兵发起的。

sentences.en: Which led me to another question I had for Burkhardt.
sentences.zh: 这引出了我问伯克哈德的另一个问题。

sentences.en: Two years ago, I was told by your agency that you did not see a network.
sentences.zh: 两年前，你们机构告诉我，你们没有发现网络。

sentences.en: But I found in my reporting that there was, in fact, a network of people who knew each other across the country.
sentences.zh: 但我在报道中发现，实际上存在一个遍布全国、成员相互认识的网络。

sentences.en: Do you see a network?
sentences.zh: 你们看到网络了吗？

sentences.en: Burkhardt tells me that the agency now sees networks.
sentences.zh: 伯克哈德告诉我，该机构现在看到了网络的存在。

sentences.en: He says that for a long time it overwhelmingly treated suspected cases as single cases, Einzelfälle.
sentences.zh: 他说，长期以来，他们绝大多数情况下将疑似案件视为单一案件（Einzelfälle）。

sentences.en: But they now make it a point to systematically study how all these cases are related.
sentences.zh: 但他们现在开始系统地研究所有这些案件是如何关联的。

sentences.en: And not only that, he acknowledges that some of these networks stretch beyond the military into other state institutions and also civilian life.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他还承认其中一些网络延伸到了军队之外，进入了其他国家机构以及平民生活。

sentences.en: and so they've started working much more closely with the domestic intelligence agency and law enforcement to avoid extremists slipping through the net
sentences.zh: 因此，他们开始与国内情报机构和执法部门更紧密地合作，以防止极端分子成为漏网之鱼。

sentences.en: As he's telling me this it sounds to me like the case of Franco A and the network it uncovered has fundamentally shifted how the agency understands the nature of the threat
sentences.zh: 当他告诉我这些时，听起来弗朗索瓦·A的案件及其揭露的网络从根本上改变了该机构对威胁性质的理解。

sentences.en: Burkhardt says that essentially their definition of what an extremist is had been far too narrow.
sentences.zh: 伯克哈德说，本质上，他们对极端分子的定义太狭隘了。

sentences.en: It used to be that an extremist was defined as someone who belonged to an extremist organization and was ready to commit violence.
sentences.zh: 过去，极端分子被定义为属于极端组织并准备实施暴力的人。

sentences.en: But now, he says, an extremist is anyone who's disloyal to the Constitution or doesn't actively stand up for its values.
sentences.zh: 但现在，他说，极端分子是指任何对宪法不忠诚或不积极捍卫其价值观的人。

sentences.en: It's a definition that better reflects what the far-right can look like today.
sentences.zh: 这个定义更好地反映了当今极右翼的面貌。

sentences.en: The kind of new right who often don't have a formal affiliation with an extremist organization, but have anti-constitutional views all the same.
sentences.zh: 那种通常与极端组织没有正式隶属关系，但却持有反宪法观点的新右翼。

sentences.en: People like Franco A.
sentences.zh: 像弗朗索瓦·A那样的人。

sentences.en: or the people who tried to storm the Reichstag.
sentences.zh: 或者那些试图冲击国会大厦的人。

sentences.en: So, some newspapers have called this network a shadow army.
sentences.zh: 那么，一些报纸称这个网络为“影子军队”。

sentences.en: Are you concerned that there is such a thing as a shadow army?
sentences.zh: 你是否担心存在所谓的“影子军队”？

sentences.en: When I ask Burkhardt if he's concerned about a shadow army, he's adamant that the networks they've identified don't rise to that level.
sentences.zh: 当我问伯克哈德是否担心影子军队时，他坚称他们发现的网络还没有达到那个程度。

sentences.en: But he says it's still a threat.
sentences.zh: 但他表示这仍然是一个威胁，

sentences.en: because there are people who dream of forming one.
sentences.zh: 因为确实有人梦想组建这样一支军队。

sentences.en: The question of a shadow army was something Parliament had been looking into too.
sentences.zh: 关于影子军队的问题也是议会一直在调查的事情。

sentences.en: When I began my reporting, the committee in charge of overseeing the intelligence agencies, including military counterintelligence, had already started their own investigation.
sentences.zh: 当我开始报道时，负责监督情报机构（包括军事反情报机构）的委员会已经开始了他们自己的调查。

sentences.en: I think it's the next one.
sentences.zh: 我想是下一个。

sentences.en: So we went to see the deputy chair of that committee.
sentences.zh: 所以我们去见了该委员会的副主席。

sentences.en: I'm Konstantin von Notz, and I'm since 2009 here in the German Bundestag for the Green Party.
sentences.zh: 我是康斯坦丁·冯·诺茨，自2009年起作为绿党成员在德国联邦议院工作。

sentences.en: Konstantin von Notz.
sentences.zh: 康斯坦丁·冯·诺茨。

sentences.en: And so you launched that report.
sentences.zh: 所以你们发起了那份报告。

sentences.en: Konstantin's committee had asked a special investigator to look into how serious the infiltration in the military was.
sentences.zh: 康斯坦丁的委员会要求一名特别调查员调查军队内部的渗透程度有多严重。

sentences.en: And he came to a somewhat different conclusion than what I'd heard from Burkhardt.
sentences.zh: 他得出的结论与我从伯克哈德那里听到的有些不同。

sentences.en: And what did you find?
sentences.zh: 你们发现了什么？

sentences.en: One of the headlines after this report was that there was no shadow army that was almost taking over the country.
sentences.zh: 这份报告发布后的标题之一是，并没有一支几乎要接管国家的影子军队。

sentences.en: But he didn't say that this does not exiSt.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有说这不存在。

sentences.en: Well, the investigator said there's no evidence of a shadow army ready to stage a coup.
sentences.zh: 嗯，调查员说没有证据表明有一支准备发动政变的影子军队。

sentences.en: He said he couldn't rule one out either.
sentences.zh: 他也说不能排除这种可能性。

sentences.en: And his investigation is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 而且他的调查仍在进行中。

sentences.en: You shouldn't be entwarned, yeah?
sentences.zh: 你不应该感到“放心”，对吧？

sentences.en: Reassured.
sentences.zh: 放心。

sentences.en: Reassured.
sentences.zh: 放心。

sentences.en: You should take serious what's happening.
sentences.zh: 你应该认真对待正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: The word shadow army is very loaded in Germany because, you know, there was something like a shadow army in the 1920s.
sentences.zh: “影子军队”这个词在德国非常敏感，因为你知道，20世纪20年代曾有过类似影子军队的东西。

sentences.en: There were plots to overthrow the government.
sentences.zh: 当时有推翻政府的阴谋。

sentences.en: There were people hoarding weapons and ammunition.
sentences.zh: 有人囤积武器和弹药。

sentences.en: And when you hear the word shadow army as a German, you do kind of get goosebumps.
sentences.zh: 当德国人听到“影子军队”这个词时，确实会起鸡皮疙瘩。

sentences.en: Oh, you better get goosebumps because this is a serious security threat to Germany and to this democratic system, and we have to deal with that.
sentences.zh: 哦，你最好起鸡皮疙瘩，因为这对德国和这个民主制度来说是一个严重的安全威胁，我们必须处理它。

sentences.en: For Konstantin, the infiltration of the military by far-right extremists is a reflection of a much bigger phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 对康斯坦丁来说，极右翼极端分子对军队的渗透是一个更大现象的反映。

sentences.en: A couple of floors up from his office are offices of the AfD.
sentences.zh: 在他办公室楼上几层是德国选择党（AfD）的办公室。

sentences.en: The first far-right party to be elected to the German parliament since the Nazis.
sentences.zh: 这是自纳粹以来第一个进入德国议会的极右翼政党。

sentences.en: It's only been around for eight years.
sentences.zh: 它成立才八年。

sentences.en: But it's now the main opposition party in the German parliament.
sentences.zh: 但它现在是德国议会的主要反对党。

sentences.en: And it's broken every taboo in Germany's post-war playbook.
sentences.zh: 它打破了德国战后准则中的每一个禁忌。

sentences.en: It's nationaliSt.
sentences.zh: 它是民族主义的。

sentences.en: to fight an invasion of foreigners.
sentences.zh: 为了对抗外国人的入侵。

sentences.en: Anti-immigrant.
sentences.zh: 反移民。

sentences.en: It plays on real fears about refugees.
sentences.zh: 它利用人们对难民的真实恐惧。

sentences.en: Wants to close mosques and stop immigration.
sentences.zh: 想要关闭清真寺并停止移民。

sentences.en: Staunchly defends the notion of Germany as a Christian state.
sentences.zh: 坚定地捍卫德国作为基督教国家的观念。

sentences.en: It challenges Germany's atonement for the HolocauSt.
sentences.zh: 它挑战德国对大屠杀的赎罪。

sentences.en: They claim Nazi history takes up too much school time and say the culture of remembrance is bad for Germany.
sentences.zh: 他们声称纳粹历史占用了太多的学校时间，并称这种纪念文化对德国不利。

sentences.en: And it has close links to extremists.
sentences.zh: 而且它与极端分子有密切联系。

sentences.en: Several members of Nordkreutz, the northern branch of the network Franco A was a part of, were also members of the AFD.
sentences.zh: “北方十字”（Nordkreutz）的几名成员，即弗朗索瓦·A所属网络的北部支系，也是德国选择党的成员。

sentences.en: And a friend of Franco A's, a fellow officer, who was initially accused of being one of his accomplices, was later hired to work inside parliament for an AFD lawmaker,
sentences.zh: 弗朗索瓦·A的一位朋友，也是一名军官，最初被指控为他的同谋之一，后来被聘为德国选择党议员的议会工作人员，

sentences.en: himself a soldier.
sentences.zh: 他本人也是一名士兵。

sentences.en: The party actively recruits police officers and soldiers, and its leaders openly march with extremists on the street.
sentences.zh: 该党积极招募警察和士兵，其领导人公开与街头的极端分子一起游行。

sentences.en: In fact, some of them were among the tens of thousands of people in the crowd, on the day that group of protesters tried to storm the Reichstag.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在那群抗议者试图冲击国会大厦的那天，他们中的一些人就在成千上万的人群中。

sentences.en: And Konstantin points to what happened a few months after that, during another mass demonstration,
sentences.zh: 康斯坦丁指出了那之后几个月，在另一次大规模示威期间发生的事情，

sentences.en: when AFD lawmakers invited a handful of protesters inside the parliament building.
sentences.zh: 当时德国选择党的议员邀请了几名抗议者进入议会大厦。

sentences.en: People were going everywhere and knocking on offices of the parliamentarians.
sentences.zh: 人们到处走动，敲打议员的办公室门。

sentences.en: So a strong violation of the integrity of this building.
sentences.zh: 这是对这座建筑完整性的严重侵犯。

sentences.en: They walked around, shouted derogatory insults at a minister, and intimidated lawmakers before an important vote.
sentences.zh: 他们在投票前四处走动，对一名部长大喊侮辱性言语，并恐吓议员。

sentences.en: And everybody locked their doors so nobody could come in.
sentences.zh: 每个人都锁上了门，这样就没人能进来了。

sentences.en: So your staff locked these doors that we're seeing here.
sentences.zh: 所以你的员工锁上了我们在这里看到的这些门。

sentences.en: They locked the doors to make sure.
sentences.zh: 他们锁上了门以确保万无一失。

sentences.en: It's this attitude toward democratic institutions that worries Konstantin.
sentences.zh: 正是这种对民主制度的态度让康斯坦丁感到担忧。

sentences.en: So democracy doesn't prevent that people get elected that are anti-democratic.
sentences.zh: 所以民主并不能阻止反民主的人当选。

sentences.en: People use democracy as a train.
sentences.zh: 人们把民主当作一列火车。

sentences.en: and when they're in the train station, they step out.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达火车站时，他们就会下车。

sentences.en: Step out and what would you then?
sentences.zh: 下车之后，他们会做什么呢？

sentences.en: Step out of the train of democracy and they reach their goal with that and then they dance.
sentences.zh: 跳下民主这列火车，他们就达到了目的，然后就开始狂欢。

sentences.en: So you use democracy to get into power and then you get rid of democracy.
sentences.zh: 所以你利用民主来获得权力，然后就抛弃了民主。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a form of infiltration and if you look into history, it can be very successful.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一种渗透形式，如果你回顾历史，它可能会非常成功。

sentences.en: For Konstantin, all of this comes down to one of the biggest lessons of World War II.
sentences.zh: 对康斯坦丁来说，这一切归结为二战中最重要的教训之一。

sentences.en: In the Weimar Republic, the Nazis were in free elections.
sentences.zh: 在魏玛共和国时期，纳粹是通过自由选举上台的。

sentences.en: That Hitler's Nazi party was democratically elected.
sentences.zh: 希特勒的纳粹党是民主选举产生的。

sentences.en: And it was only once they were in office that they abolished democracy.
sentences.zh: 而他们一旦掌权，就废除了民主。

sentences.en: So that's the reason why we have to understand where the infiltration can happen.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们必须了解渗透可能在何处发生的原因。

sentences.en: We should not be naive.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该天真。

sentences.en: On our way out, Konstantin walks us to the elevator.
sentences.zh: 在离开的路上，康斯坦丁把我们送到电梯口。

sentences.en: He tells us that just a few weeks earlier...
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，就在几周前……

sentences.en: I came in here on my regular way to my office, and there was this swastika.
sentences.zh: 我像往常一样去办公室，结果看到了这个万字旗。

sentences.en: Someone had carved a swastika into its metal doors.
sentences.zh: 有人在金属门上刻了一个万字旗。

sentences.en: If you scratch that into a door of the German parliament, that's a symbolic attack against democracy.
sentences.zh: 如果你在德国议会的大门上刻下这个符号，那就是对民主的象征性攻击。

sentences.en: The perpetrator was never identified.
sentences.zh: 肇事者从未被查出。

sentences.en: But given the strict security in the building, there's a pretty good chance that whoever did this knew someone or was someone working inside parliament.
sentences.zh: 但考虑到大楼内严格的安保措施，很有可能做这件事的人认识议会内部的人，或者本身就是议会内部的工作人员。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Go one by one.
sentences.zh: 一个一个来。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What makes Germany's democracy so unique is that after the war, it was rebuilt to be what's called a defensive democracy.
sentences.zh: 德国民主的独特之处在于，战后它被重建为所谓的“防御性民主”。

sentences.en: The idea was that because Hitler's Nazi party was elected and they only got rid of democracy once they were in government,
sentences.zh: 其理念是，由于希特勒的纳粹党是选举产生的，而且他们一旦进入政府就废除了民主，

sentences.en: Germany equipped its democracy with the tools to protect itself against threats from the inside.
sentences.zh: 因此德国为自己的民主配备了保护自身免受内部威胁的工具。

sentences.en: Tell me where we are.
sentences.zh: 告诉我我们在哪里。

sentences.en: One of these tools is the Domestic Intelligence Agency.
sentences.zh: 其中一个工具就是联邦宪法保卫局。

sentences.en: It's actually called the Office for the Protection of the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 它实际上被称为“宪法保卫办公室”。

sentences.en: Like other domestic intelligence agencies, it monitors domestic threats.
sentences.zh: 和其他国内情报机构一样，它负责监控国内威胁。

sentences.en: But it was also set up as a kind of early warning system for democracy, with the power to put individuals, organizations, and even political parties
sentences.zh: 但它也被设立为一种民主的预警系统，有权对个人、组织甚至政党进行监视，

sentences.en: suspected of being a threat to democracy, under surveillance.
sentences.zh: 如果他们被怀疑对民主构成威胁的话。

sentences.en: Basically, this office determines who is crossing the line into extremism.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这个机构决定了谁越过了极端主义的界限。

sentences.en: So I went with producers Claire Tennesketter and Lindsay Garrison to talk to the man who runs this office.
sentences.zh: 所以我与制片人克莱尔·特内斯凯特和琳赛·加里森一起去采访了该机构的负责人。

sentences.en: His name is Thomas Haldenwang.
sentences.zh: 他的名字是托马斯·哈尔登旺。

sentences.en: It's a pleasure to have you here, but we will do it in German language.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来，但我们将用德语进行交流。

sentences.en: He's worked at the agency for over a decade, but only became president in 2018.
sentences.zh: 他在该机构工作了十多年，但直到2018年才成为局长。

sentences.en: Both of his predecessors were caught up in scandals involving far-right extremism.
sentences.zh: 他的前两任局长都卷入了涉及极右翼极端主义的丑闻。

sentences.en: The first resigned after the office failed in its handling of the NSU murders, and the second was reassigned after playing down anti-immigrant violence during a neo-Nazi riot.
sentences.zh: 第一任局长因该机构在处理“国社地下党”（NSU）谋杀案中的失职而辞职，第二任局长则因在一次新纳粹骚乱中淡化反移民暴力事件而被调职。

sentences.en: He's since become a hero of the far-right.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他成了极右翼眼中的英雄。

sentences.en: And while his predecessors were primarily concerned with Islamist extremism, Thomas has shifted the agency's focus.
sentences.zh: 虽然他的前任主要关注伊斯兰极端主义，但托马斯改变了该机构的重点。

sentences.en: He says that far-right extremism and far-right terrorism are now the biggest threats to democracy.
sentences.zh: 他表示，极右翼极端主义和极右翼恐怖主义现在是对民主最大的威胁。

sentences.en: Would you say that there's an increase in the far-right terrorist threat in Germany right now?
sentences.zh: 你认为德国目前的极右翼恐怖主义威胁是否在增加？

sentences.en: He mentions recent terrorist attacks, like the murder of Walter Lübcke, a regional politician who supported Chancellor Merkel's refugee policy
sentences.zh: 他提到了近期的恐怖袭击，比如沃尔特·吕贝克的谋杀案，他是一位支持默克尔总理难民政策的地区政治家，

sentences.en: and who was shot at close range by a well-known neo-Nazi.
sentences.zh: 被一名著名的新纳粹分子近距离射杀。

sentences.en: He also talks about the attack on a synagogue in Halle, where a far-right extremist killed two people after his plans for a massacre failed.
sentences.zh: 他还谈到了哈雷犹太教堂的袭击事件，一名极右翼极端分子在屠杀计划失败后杀害了两人。

sentences.en: After these attacks, the spotlight turned to the AfD, and its nationalist anti-immigrant rhetoric, which some people said was empowering extremists to commit violence.
sentences.zh: 这些袭击发生后，焦点转向了德国选择党（AfD）及其民族主义反移民言论，一些人称这些言论助长了极端分子的暴力行为。

sentences.en: And by the time we meet with Thomas, his office is already looking into the party.
sentences.zh: 当我们见到托马斯时，他的办公室已经在调查该党了。

sentences.en: They placed two of the most extreme factions under surveillance,
sentences.zh: 他们将该党最极端的两个派系置于监视之下，

sentences.en: a group known as the Wing
sentences.zh: 一个被称为“侧翼”的组织，

sentences.en: and the Youth Organization, the Young Alternative.
sentences.zh: 以及青年组织“青年选择”。

sentences.en: Both factions stood out in the party for their links to extremist groups and for claiming that ethnic and religious differences between people make immigration a threat to Germany,
sentences.zh: 这两个派系在党内因与极端组织有联系，并声称人与人之间的种族和宗教差异使移民成为德国的威胁而引人注目，

sentences.en: which for Thomas is a violation of the Constitution, and in particular its first article, which states the dignity of human beings is untouchable.
sentences.zh: 这对托马斯来说是违反宪法的，特别是宪法第一条，即“人之尊严不可侵犯”。

sentences.en: And for Thomas, where the dignity of people is questioned, where people are degraded and humiliated as a group,
sentences.zh: 对托马斯而言，凡是质疑人的尊严，凡是将人们作为一个群体进行贬低和羞辱的地方，

sentences.en: that crosses the line into extremism and has the potential of fomenting violence.
sentences.zh: 就越过了极端主义的界限，并有可能煽动暴力。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Not long after we talked to Thomas,
sentences.zh: 在我们与托马斯交谈后不久，

sentences.en: there was another far-right terrorist attack.
sentences.zh: 又发生了一起极右翼恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: A man walked into multiple locations in the city of Hanau and shot and killed nine people.
sentences.zh: 一名男子走进哈瑙市的多个地点，开枪打死了九个人。

sentences.en: He shot straight to the head of everyone he saw.
sentences.zh: 他对着他看到的每个人的头部直接射击。

sentences.en: He laid down and then he fired at all of us.
sentences.zh: 他趴下，然后向我们所有人开火。

sentences.en: All of them with migrant backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 他们都有移民背景。

sentences.en: Before the gunman returned home and shot both himself and his elderly mother, he published a manifesto filled with the same hatred for migrants that is often heard from the AfD.
sentences.zh: 在枪手回家并射杀自己及其年迈的母亲之前，他发表了一份宣言，其中充满了在德国选择党中经常听到的那种对移民的仇恨。

sentences.en: German leaders are calling out the quote, poison, that is, hatred and racism.
sentences.zh: 德国领导人正在公开谴责所谓的“毒药”，即仇恨和种族主义。

sentences.en: The news of the Hanau attack shook Germany.
sentences.zh: 哈瑙袭击事件的消息震惊了德国。

sentences.en: The AfD condemned it.
sentences.zh: 德国选择党对此表示谴责。

sentences.en: But once again...
sentences.zh: 但再一次……

sentences.en: The AfD is to blame for creating a basis for exactly the kind of thinking that led to the shootings.
sentences.zh: 德国选择党应为制造导致枪击事件的那种思想基础而受到指责。

sentences.en: Many people said the party's anti-immigrant rhetoric shared the blame.
sentences.zh: 许多人表示，该党的反移民言论难辞其咎。

sentences.en: They should be under surveillance for some of their language.
sentences.zh: 他们的一些言论应该受到监视。

sentences.en: And some started calling on the Office for the Protection of the Constitution to put the entire AfD under surveillance.
sentences.zh: 一些人开始呼吁宪法保卫局将整个德国选择党置于监视之下。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Germany's domestic intelligence agency has placed the country's largest opposition party, the far-right alternative for Germany, under surveillance.
sentences.zh: 德国国内情报机构已将该国最大的反对党——极右翼的德国选择党置于监视之下。

sentences.en: In early 2021, Thomas and his office did.
sentences.zh: 2021年初，托马斯和他的办公室这样做了。

sentences.en: It is a big constitutional step to put a whole party under surveillance.
sentences.zh: 将整个政党置于监视之下是一个重大的宪法举措。

sentences.en: It was the first time in its post-war history that Germany put its main opposition party under surveillance.
sentences.zh: 这是德国战后历史上首次将主要反对党置于监视之下。

sentences.en: And it's probably the most dramatic move by any Western democracy to act against the far right.
sentences.zh: 这可能是西方民主国家为对抗极右翼所采取的最激进的举措。

sentences.en: Intelligence services are now formally monitoring the party for having suspected links to right-wing extremism.
sentences.zh: 情报部门现在正式监控该党，因为其涉嫌与右翼极端主义有联系。

sentences.en: It meant that the agency could tap phones and emails and monitor the movements of any of the AfD's nearly 32,000 members.
sentences.zh: 这意味着该机构可以窃听电话、查看电子邮件，并监控德国选择党近32000名成员中任何人的行踪。

sentences.en: And if, in the end, the agency found enough evidence to classify the party as extremist, it would also mean that party members who work for state institutions like teachers,
sentences.zh: 如果最终该机构发现足够的证据将该党列为极端组织，这也意味着为国家机构工作的党员，如教师、

sentences.en: court officials, police officers or soldiers could potentially lose their jobs.
sentences.zh: 法院官员、警察或士兵，可能会失去工作。

sentences.en: The party could even be banned.
sentences.zh: 该党甚至可能被取缔。

sentences.en: The day after the news breaks,
sentences.zh: 消息传出的第二天，

sentences.en: The AfD holds a rally in Offenbach, the same city Franco A is from.
sentences.zh: 德国选择党在奥芬巴赫举行集会，这也是弗朗哥·A的家乡。

sentences.en: And the featured speaker is the party's most notorious figure, Björn Höcke.
sentences.zh: 主讲人是该党最臭名昭著的人物比约恩·赫克。

sentences.en: He leads the AFD in the state of Thuringia, the same state where the NSU terrorists grew up.
sentences.zh: 他领导着图林根州的德国选择党，也就是那些国社地下党恐怖分子长大的州。

sentences.en: He's a former history teacher who says that Germany needs a 180-degree change in looking at its paSt.
sentences.zh: 他曾是一名历史老师，他说德国在看待过去时需要进行180度的转变。

sentences.en: He calls the Holocaust Memorial in Berlin a monument of shame.
sentences.zh: 他称柏林的犹太人大屠杀纪念碑为“耻辱纪念碑”。

sentences.en: A few years ago, a German broadcaster read quotes from Höcke to AFD members and asked them whether Höcke or Hitler said it.
sentences.zh: 几年前，一家德国广播公司向德国选择党成员朗读了赫克的语录，并询问他们这是赫克说的还是希特勒说的。

sentences.en: Most of them were stumped.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数人都被难住了。

sentences.en: Björn Höcke is so extreme that one court ruled, you can legitimately call him a fasciSt.
sentences.zh: 比约恩·赫克太极端了，以至于一家法院裁定，你可以合法地称他为法西斯分子。

sentences.en: He denied my request for an interview.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝了我的采访请求。

sentences.en: But when he addresses the crowd, he says,
sentences.zh: 但当他向人群发表讲话时，他说，

sentences.en: the Office for the Protection of the Constitution is spying on the AfD.
sentences.zh: 宪法保卫局正在监视德国选择党。

sentences.en: that it is using wartime methods and that it wants to destroy the party.
sentences.zh: 它正在使用战时手段，并试图摧毁该党。

sentences.en: He says the government is run by politicians who hate Germany
sentences.zh: 他说政府是由仇恨德国的政客管理的，

sentences.en: and want to destroy the German nation by embracing multiculturalism.
sentences.zh: 他们想通过拥抱多元文化主义来摧毁德国民族。

sentences.en: He says the AfD is the only party that loves Germany.
sentences.zh: 他说德国选择党是唯一热爱德国的政党。

sentences.en: When we talk to people at the rally.
sentences.zh: 当我们与集会上的人交谈时。

sentences.en: It's a clear danger to free speech and the whole democracy.
sentences.zh: 这对言论自由和整个民主构成了明显的危险。

sentences.en: They say the office for the protection of the constitution is wrong to put them under surveillance.
sentences.zh: 他们说宪法保卫局将他们置于监视之下是错误的。

sentences.en: They say it's being used as a political instrument of the left.
sentences.zh: 他们说这被用作左翼的政治工具。

sentences.en: Because it's against political culture to suspect that people are criminals just because they are a member of a political party.
sentences.zh: 因为仅仅因为人们是某个政党的成员就怀疑他们是罪犯，这违背了政治文化。

sentences.en: That's wrong.
sentences.zh: 那是错误的。

sentences.en: And that it's undermining the Constitution rather than protecting it.
sentences.zh: 而且这正在破坏宪法，而不是保护它。

sentences.en: They tell us you're living in a democracy, but at the same time they are trying to influence people to change their opinion, to follow, to be quiet, to be a good citizen.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们，你生活在民主国家，但同时他们试图影响人们改变观点，去顺从，去安静，去做一个好公民。

sentences.en: And you're only a good citizen if you shut up.
sentences.zh: 而你只有闭嘴才是一个好公民。

sentences.en: Some of them question whether they're living in a democracy at all.
sentences.zh: 他们中有些人质疑自己是否真的生活在民主国家。

sentences.en: And this, in a way, is the central dilemma of Germany's defensive democracy.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这就是德国防御性民主的核心困境。

sentences.en: In trying to draw the line on what constitutes extremism, it will be accused of crossing a line itself.
sentences.zh: 在试图划定什么是极端主义的界限时，它本身也会被指责越界。

sentences.en: That's what the AfD is arguing.
sentences.zh: 这就是德国选择党所争论的。

sentences.en: In the end,
sentences.zh: 最终，

sentences.en: the federal constitutional court will indeed have to decide whether or not a position that is fundamentally critical of government policy is permitted in our liberal democracy.
sentences.zh: 联邦宪法法院确实将不得不决定，在我们的自由民主国家中，是否允许存在根本上批评政府政策的立场。

sentences.en: When it became public that the party was now officially suspected of far-right extremism and could come under surveillance, they immediately filed a legal challenge.
sentences.zh: 当该党现在正式被怀疑有极右翼极端主义倾向并可能受到监视的消息公开时，他们立即提起了法律诉讼。

sentences.en: claiming that this could interfere with their chances in the upcoming national election, one of the most pivotal elections in years, as Chancellor Angela Merkel leaves office.
sentences.zh: 声称这可能会干扰他们在即将到来的大选中的机会，这是多年来最关键的选举之一，因为安格拉·默克尔总理即将离任。

sentences.en: Soon after, a German court ordered the Office for the Protection of the Constitution to suspend their surveillance of the party, pending the outcome of the case.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，一家德国法院下令宪法保卫局暂停对该党的监视，等待案件结果。

sentences.en: But a handful of states already have their local chapters of the AFD under surveillance.
sentences.zh: 但少数几个州已经将其地方分支机构置于监视之下。

sentences.en: We're talking about up to one-fourth of the population that has a different point of view.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是多达四分之一的人口持有不同的观点。

sentences.en: Including the eastern state of Thuringia, where the party gets almost one in four votes, twice the national average.
sentences.zh: 包括东部的图林根州，该党在那里获得了近四分之一的选票，是全国平均水平的两倍。

sentences.en: That's the state where Stephen Kramer heads the regional branch of the Office for the Protection of the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·克莱默就是该州宪法保卫局地区分支机构的负责人。

sentences.en: So voters of the AFD, they don't feel this is a real democracy if it targets the party they vote for.
sentences.zh: 所以德国选择党的选民认为，如果民主针对他们投票支持的政党，那这就不是真正的民主。

sentences.en: So how do you explain this decision to them?
sentences.zh: 那么你如何向他们解释这个决定呢？

sentences.en: That's exactly what they are saying.
sentences.zh: 这正是他们所说的。

sentences.en: They see the federal democracy as a dictatorship.
sentences.zh: 他们将联邦民主视为独裁。

sentences.en: But what we're talking about is a party that promotes hatred, that promotes racism, that promotes the idea of bypassing and overcoming the principles of a democracy.
sentences.zh: 但我们谈论的是一个宣扬仇恨、宣扬种族主义、宣扬绕过和克服民主原则理念的政党。

sentences.en: And that is clearly not within the framework of a democratic exchange of even radical opinions.
sentences.zh: 这显然不在民主交流甚至激进观点表达的框架内。

sentences.en: But yeah, you're right.
sentences.zh: 但是的，你是对的。

sentences.en: It's hard to explain.
sentences.zh: 这很难解释。

sentences.en: Stephen admits that it's a tough sell, telling voters that defending democracy can involve spying on their party of choice.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬承认这很难让人接受，告诉选民捍卫民主可能涉及监视他们选择的政党。

sentences.en: So in many ways, the question is, are those tools that this democracy has given itself, are they strong enough?
sentences.zh: 所以在很多方面，问题在于，这个民主国家赋予自己的这些工具，它们足够强大吗？

sentences.en: Look, this is one of the most severe tests that we are in right now as a defensive democracy.
sentences.zh: 看，这是我们作为防御性民主国家目前面临的最严峻的考验之一。

sentences.en: But state agencies, public agencies are only one part of it.
sentences.zh: 但国家机构、公共机构只是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: He says that even if Germany's institutions do everything right.
sentences.zh: 他说，即使德国的机构做的一切都是正确的。

sentences.en: The general defense line are the citizens and people of the democracies who are supposed to participate in elections.
sentences.zh: 一般的防线是民主国家的公民和人民，他们应该参与选举，

sentences.en: in an ongoing democratic society.
sentences.zh: 参与持续的民主社会。

sentences.en: The institutions alone can't protect against what once put the Nazis in power in the first place,
sentences.zh: 单靠机构无法防止曾经让纳粹上台的东西，

sentences.en: the people who voted for them.
sentences.zh: 即那些投票给他们的人。

sentences.en: If this democracy doesn't find the majority of citizens that is in favor of it, you can have the best laws and the best agencies, but they will not be able to protect democracy.
sentences.zh: 如果这个民主国家找不到支持它的大多数公民，你可以拥有最好的法律和最好的机构，但它们将无法保护民主。

sentences.en: The Office for the Protection of the Constitution remains locked in a legal tug-of-war with the AFD.
sentences.zh: 宪法保卫局仍与德国选择党陷入法律拉锯战中。

sentences.en: And at a time when the memory of the Nazi era is fading into history, it's just one of many tests that Germany is facing.
sentences.zh: 在纳粹时代的记忆逐渐淡出历史之际，这只是德国面临的众多考验之一。

sentences.en: The trial of Franco A.
sentences.zh: 弗朗哥·A的审判。

sentences.en: is another.
sentences.zh: 是另一个。

sentences.en: Both cases will set a historic precedent and will define the point where people or parties cross the line into extremism.
sentences.zh: 这两个案例都将树立历史先例，并界定个人或政党越过极端主义界限的临界点。

sentences.en: and where extremism crosses the line into terrorism.
sentences.zh: 以及极端主义越过界限演变为恐怖主义的临界点。

sentences.en: And ultimately, they'll start to answer whether the institutions Germany put in place after the war are working in the way they're meant to,
sentences.zh: 最终，它们将开始回答德国战后建立的体制是否正按预期运作，

sentences.en: or if they'll provoke an even stronger backlash against liberal democracy itself.
sentences.zh: 还是会引发针对自由民主制度本身更强烈的反弹。

sentences.en: You look on Germany, if you look on Europe, the house is on fire.
sentences.zh: 看看德国，看看欧洲，这房子已经着火了。

sentences.en: This was long before you had your problems with QAnon and the extreme right that is now basically understood as domestic terrorism in the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 这远在你们遭遇“匿名者Q”（QAnon）和极右翼问题之前，而这些问题现在基本上被视为美国境内的本土恐怖主义。

sentences.en: And I admit nobody of us thought the pictures of storming Capitol Hill and everything else that that could happen in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我承认，我们谁也没想到冲击国会山之类的画面会发生在美国。

sentences.en: But I'm not surprised anymore.
sentences.zh: 但我现在已经不感到惊讶了。

sentences.en: And I'm afraid to tell you guys and our guys, this is not the end of the story.
sentences.zh: 恐怕我得告诉你们，也告诉我们的人，这还不是故事的终点。

sentences.en: We're just in the middle of that fight.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于这场斗争的中心。

sentences.en: In June 2021, over four years after Franco A's arrest and the discovery of a nationwide network of far-right extremists,
sentences.zh: 2021年6月，在弗朗哥·A（Franco A）被捕并发现一个全国性极右翼极端分子网络四年多后，

sentences.en: the Office for the Protection of the Constitution released its latest report.
sentences.zh: 德国联邦宪法保卫局发布了最新报告。

sentences.en: And in some ways, it looks like previous reports.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，它看起来和之前的报告如出一辙。

sentences.en: It has the usual statistics.
sentences.zh: 里面有惯常的统计数据。

sentences.en: The number of suspected far-right extremists is now up to 33,000.
sentences.zh: 疑似极右翼极端分子的数量现已上升至33,000人。

sentences.en: And 40% of them are ready to commit violence.
sentences.zh: 其中40%的人准备实施暴力。

sentences.en: But this time, there's a new section on the new right.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，关于“新右翼”有一个新的章节。

sentences.en: And it lists a whole range of targets the office now has under surveillance.
sentences.zh: 它列出了一系列该机构目前正在监视的目标。

sentences.en: a far-right think tank, a far-right magazine, a far-right publishing house, a far-right marketing group.
sentences.zh: 一家极右翼智库、一本极右翼杂志、一家极右翼出版社、一个极右翼营销团体。

sentences.en: It's basically watching the entire ecosystem of far-right extremism.
sentences.zh: 它基本上是在监视整个极右翼极端主义生态系统。

sentences.en: And then there's something else, another new section that talks about extremists inside Germany's security agencies.
sentences.zh: 此外还有别的内容，另一个新章节讨论了德国安全机构内部的极端分子。

sentences.en: It talks about far-right chat groups and threat letters signed NSU 2.0, about police officers hoarding weapons and ammunition.
sentences.zh: 它谈到了极右翼聊天群组和署名为“NSU 2.0”的威胁信，以及警察囤积武器和弹药的情况。

sentences.en: It says there are around 1,400 cases of far-right extremists who have infiltrated the military, police, and other state institutions.
sentences.zh: 报告称，约有1,400起极右翼极端分子渗透进军队、警察和其他国家机构的案例。

sentences.en: The report warns that these people who have special training, access to weapons, and sensitive information represent a significant danger for the state and for society.
sentences.zh: 报告警告说，这些受过特殊训练、能接触武器和敏感信息的人，对国家和社会构成了重大威胁。

sentences.en: And it raises the alarm about the day many of them are preparing for, or even trying to trigger, Day X.
sentences.zh: 它还对许多人正在准备、甚至试图触发的那一天——“X日”（Day X）——发出了警报。

sentences.en: and by Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 以及丹·鲍威尔（Dan Powell）。

sentences.en: Research and fact-checking by Caitlin Love.
sentences.zh: 研究与事实核查由凯特琳·洛夫（Caitlin Love）负责。

sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请在您收听播客的地方搜索《X日》，并点击订阅。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢安妮塔·巴达霍（Anita Badajo），

sentences.en: Nora Keller,
sentences.zh: 诺拉·凯勒（Nora Keller），

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是您今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: We had a really good meeting.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了一次非常好的会谈。

sentences.en: and answer your direct question, we have a deal.
sentences.zh: 回答你的直接问题，我们达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: On Thursday, after weeks of negotiations,
sentences.zh: 周四，经过数周的谈判，

sentences.en: President Biden struck a deal with a bipartisan group of 10 senators on nearly $600 billion in spending on infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统与一个由10名参议员组成的两党小组就近6000亿美元的基础设施支出达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: None of us got all that we wanted.
sentences.zh: 我们谁都没有得到自己想要的一切。

sentences.en: I clearly didn't get all I wanted.
sentences.zh: 我显然也没有得到我想要的一切。

sentences.en: They gave more than I think maybe they were inclined to give in the first place.
sentences.zh: 他们付出的比我认为他们最初倾向于付出的要多。

sentences.en: That figure is far less than the $2 trillion plan
sentences.zh: 这个数字远低于拜登最初提出的2万亿美元计划。

sentences.en: Biden had originally proposed.
sentences.zh: 但如果能在共和党的支持下通过，这将代表在极端党派对立时代的一个重大政治突破。

sentences.en: But if adopted with Republican support, it would represent a significant political breakthrough in an era of hyper-partisanship.
sentences.zh: 但这也让我想起过去我们在美国国会完成大量工作的日子。

sentences.en: But this reminds me of the days we used to get an awful lot done up in the United States Congress.
sentences.zh: 民主党人希望将这项基础设施法案与另一项规模大得多的支出和增税方案捆绑在一起，而后者预计无法获得共和党的投票支持。

sentences.en: Democrats hope to pair the infrastructure bill with a much larger package of spending and tax increases that is not expected to win Republican votes.
sentences.zh: 纽约州一家法院暂时中止了鲁迪·朱利安尼（Rudy Giuliani）的律师执业资格，此前法院认定他曾多次向法官、立法者和公众撒谎，

sentences.en: And a New York state court has temporarily suspended the law license of Rudy Giuliani after finding that he had repeatedly lied to judges, lawmakers, and the public
sentences.zh: 以代表唐纳德·特朗普推翻2020年选举结果。

sentences.en: in his effort to overturn the results of the 2020 election on behalf of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 法院认定，朱利安尼的行为构成了“对公众的直接威胁”，并直接加剧了导致1月6日美国国会大厦骚乱的紧张局势。

sentences.en: The court found that Giuliani's actions represented a, quote, immediate threat to the public and had directly inflamed tensions that led to the January 6th riot at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 国会大厦。

sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》（The Daily）。

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
